arena_relation_lab.name: What Makes an Encounter?
arena_relation_lab.description: A scoped crab experiment: nominated visitor or beacon, nearest visible food, sight screen, two-second feeding and five-meal stopping threshold. Paired with collision carts to distinguish controller decisions from collision laws.
interactions: BEACON moves its nominated target; VISITOR switches between beacon and player
FOOD offers one mushroom at a time
PARTS and RULE reveal target choice, distance and feeding state
arena_relation_lab.qfep_connection: Relations change through sensing and retained state; feeding counts and stopping thresholds are programmed, not evidence of learning.
